title: Tournament Rules · Teams & format
items: There will be 10 male Teams and 3 female teams playing this season.
Each men’s team will have 8 or more players. Each women’s team will have 9 players.
In a game, a team can play only 8 players for men and 9 players for women. Please make sure to declare the name of the 8/9 players BEFORE the game begins.

Since most of the teams have requested the committee to let them stick to their previous year’s team, or have formed their own team with new players, we have decided to drop the plan to mix-match the players to create teams, so that the team spirit is high and the players enjoy the games. Thus, as per the new rule, each team is allowed to bring 8/9 or more players and form their own teams.
(Men)10 teams will be divided into 2 groups – Group A and Group B.

(Men)In each group, teams will play with all other teams in the league stage. Thus, each team will play 4 league games. Each group will have 10 league games. So, in total, there will be 20 league matches.

(Men)Out of the 5 teams in each group, top 2 teams will move to the next round. So, we’ll have 4 teams in the next round. The Rank of the team will be arranged based on points (#1 ) and NRR(#2) for each team.
(Men)4 teams will play Semi Final in this way: Group 1 Rank 1 with Group 2 Rank 2 and vice versa. Winners of both the games will play in the final.
(Women)In league stage, all 3 teams will play 1 game with other teams. So, each team will play 2 league games.
(Women)From the league games, based on points and NRR, top 2 teams will be decided,and they will play the final match.

title: Tournament Rules · Points, ties & attendance
items: Each League game will give 2 points to the winner, and 0 points to the loser. If the match is a draw, then 1 point will be allocated to each team.
In Knockout matches, if the match is a draw, then a super over will be played until a team wins. Toss will be used to decide who goes to bat/bowl first in the super over.

If there is any tie between 2 teams in the League Stage Rank table (both points and NRR), we’ll decide the rank by playing a super over, if needed. Based on the result of the super over, the rank will be decided.
If the match is cancelled by mutual agreement between the teams each team will be rewarded with 1 point.

Request every Team to show up at 10 Minutes prior to the match starting time. If 1 team shows up with enough players ( minimum 6 for men and minimum 7 for women ), while other team waiting, then we'll wait maximum 15 minutes after the declared match start time before cancelling the match. In this case, the team present on the ground will be declared winner.
If both the teams do not have enough players to play, then the match will be cancelled and it will declared as a draw.
Committee will wait maximum 15 minutes after the match start time to take the decision. We have a very tight schedule, request all the players please to co-operate.

If a team does not have required number of players for any reason, and they want to play with a smaller number of players, they are allowed to do so, provided they are on the ground on time. They should have at least 6 ( for men ) and 7 ( for women ) players for that.
In the super over, the team that will score the maximum runs will be the winner, there is no limit on number of wickets falling.
There is no super over during league games. We are short of time this year.

Semifinals and Final match will be continued until we have a winner. That is, if there is a tie, we’ll choose the winner by super over. If the super over is a draw, we’ll have another super over until we have a winner.
The schedule allocation will be random.

title: Tournament Rules · Players & authority
items: If you do not have 8 players in your team, you are free to choose anyone else who is interested join your team, even in the middle of the tournament.

No team member change is allowed during a game, unless there is an injury or any kind of emergency. It will be allowed only if the match umpires agree. Once a player leaves the match in between a game, he is not allowed to join back in the same game.
1 player cannot play from multiple teams in the tournament (even if your team is out of the tournament).
Committee will provide balls and stumps. Please bring your own bat (BYOB).
In any match, umpire’s decision will be considered as final.
In case of any confusion, committee and umpire’s decision will be final. Committee may add/modify any rule, as seems necessary.

title: Games Rules · Overs, bowling & extras
items: Each game will be of 6 overs for men and 7 overs for women.
Only 1 player can bowl 2 overs.
Bowling is to be done only by throwing the ball over the head.
2 batsmen will be batting.
Last batsman can bat alone. In that case, she/he can get run out on the side she/he is running to.
Wide ball will be 1 extra run.
No ball (full toss over the waist/ bowling with any leg completely outside the crease) will be 1 run.
If a no-ball happens because the bowler bowls from outside the crease, the next ball will be a free hit. During the free-hit ball, there are only 2 ways for a batsman to get out:
Batsman hits a ball and the ball goes over the fence outside the ground without touching the ground.
Run out
Leg bye run is not allowed.
Bye and over throw are allowed.

title: Games Rules · Ways a batsman can get out
items: Other than standard cricket rules, following ways a batsman can get out:
1 drop 1 hand catch ( should be clean - if you touch the ball twice ( caught-left-caught again with the same hand ) or with 1 hand and and 1 more body part, it's not out

Hitting the front and side boundaries (or fences/shed) directly (without touching the ground. If it touches the trees/leaves/branches, and does not touch the ground, it will still be considered as direct)  This is not a sixer. This is out.
Crossing the fences on all 4 side, without touching the ground within the boundary.
On the back fence, behind the wicketkeeper, if the batsman hits the ball and the ball crosses the fence without the bowl dropping, touching wicket or any fielder, it is out.
Hitting the house/patio directly.

Please note, (based on last year’s experiences), if the ball crosses the boundary (side fence or front) directly, but hits a tree or part of tree and then falls back within the boundary (without touching the ground outside the boundary), then that is NOT OUT. It will be 2 runs (Just for sheer LUCK! 😊 )

title: Games Rules · Boundaries & dead balls
items: There is no run if the ball touches the back fence. Batsmen are free to get runs by running.
On the side fence, if the bowl touches the ground, or a fielder/other batsman/umpire and then hits or crosses the fence, it is 2 runs.
This is 1 run if it touches the shed. Batsman will change sides.
It is 2 runs if it touches both shed and side fence.
On the front fence, that would be a 4-run
There is no 6-run shot, if you hit 6, you are out.
If the ball is very fast, the batsman can appeal. If umpire thinks the same, it will be considered as a dead ball.
If the ball is stuck within the field (let’s say, on a tree branch), it will be considered a dead ball.
2 drops before the batting crease will be a dead ball.
In any match, umpire’s decision will be considered as final.
In case of any confusion, committee and umpire’s decision will be final. Committee may add/modify any rule, as seems necessary.

title: Summary of run rule
items: Ball hits the ground/player/umpire and touches the front fence – 4 runs
Ball hits the ground/player/umpire and touches the side fence on the side of the shed / opposite fence to the house ) – 2 runs
Ball hits the ground/player/umpire and touches the shed – 1 run
Ball hits the ground/player/umpire and touches the shed and opposite side fence – 2 runs.
Ball hits the ground/player/umpire and touches the back fence and then the shed – 1 run.
Ball hits the ground/player umpire and touches the house/patio/play area – 1 run
Wide/No ball – 1 run
Ball hits any part of the tree within the boundary before hitting opposite or front fence - 1 run
Sheer Luck Rule (explained above) – 2 runs. 😊
P.S.: Every player must sign the Injury waiver form before playing any game. This is mandatory. If the player is below 18, the form MUST be signed by authorized guardian. THIS IS MANDATORY.
